business_problem: Happy Elements needed a cloud foundation that could keep a fast-growing casual game stable, responsive and cost-efficient while the team continuously shipped new content to a massive player base.
solution_summary: Happy Elements worked with Baidu AI Cloud to rebuild the infrastructure behind Happy Elimination around elastic cloud capacity and global content delivery. The migration started with Baidu cloud servers, which gave the game team elastic scale-up and scale-down control, backup and recovery features and a way to reduce wasted capacity as traffic changed. On top of compute, Baidu designed a CDN acceleration plan that distributes game content to a large edge-node footprint so players are routed to the most appropriate service node and avoid latency, loading delays or connection failures. The result is a two-layer architecture: cloud servers keep game logic and core services resilient, while the CDN and traffic-scheduling layer handle distribution close to the user. Baidu positioned the same foundation as a path to broader 'ABC plus X' digital game architecture, but the immediate win was operational stability and lower-cost scaling for a live game with very large traffic volume.

solution_components.name: Cloud Servers
solution_components.role: Provide elastic compute, backup and recovery for the game's core services.

solution_components.name: Content Delivery Network (CDN)
solution_components.role: Distributes game content to edge nodes so players get faster, more stable access.

solution_components.name: IoT Core
solution_components.role: Represents the wider Baidu digital-architecture extension path highlighted for future game scenarios.

data_flow: Game requests are served from elastic cloud-server resources while downloadable content and acceleration traffic are pushed through the CDN node network, which routes players to the best-serving edge location for lower latency and faster loading.
business_outcome: Happy Elements gained a more elastic and resilient game-delivery foundation, improving player experience while lowering waste and making infrastructure operations easier to scale.
metrics: The game serves more than 100 million players.
